glosses: The quality of being an enemy; hostile or unfriendly disposition.

examples.text: We know from their literature that to our Saxon ancestors waste places of moor and forest and marshes were the resort of a host of supernatural creatures at enmity with mankind.

examples.text: My resentment and anger towards you caused hostility and a division between us.
